title: DeclareRequest
description: What a builder reads to declare what it will change: the slice, its worktree, the practices, the files it may not change and the files it builds against.

folder.description: The slice's worktree, relative to the project, as worktrees.cut made it, such as .forge/worktrees/TR2.

practices.description: The practices files a builder reads before it writes, relative to the project, from forge's settings.

fixed.description: The files the builder may not change: every test file the slice's fails-first items name. Empty when the builder writes its own tests.

interface.description: The files the slice builds against, as the plan names them: a design's design.yaml and its request and response schema files. Empty when the plan names none.
